definitions.explanation: A pitching statistic counting the number of batters a pitcher strikes out. Viewed from the pitcher's side, in contrast to {三振|さんしん}, which is the batter striking out.

examples.japanese: あの{投手|とうしゅ}は{奪三振|だつさんしん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: That pitcher racks up a lot of strikeouts.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{試合|しあい}で{十|じゅう}{個|こ}の{奪三振|だつさんしん}を{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: He recorded ten strikeouts in today's game.

examples.japanese: {奪三振|だつさんしん}{率|りつ}はピッチャーの{能力|のうりょく}を{示|しめ}す{指標|しひょう}だ。
examples.english: Strikeout rate is a measure of a pitcher's ability.

notes:
Formed from {奪|だつ} (to seize, to take away) + {三振|さんしん} (strikeout). Counts strikeouts from the pitcher's perspective — the pitcher 'takes' the strikeout.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {三振|さんしん}: strikeout — the same event seen from the batter's side
- {奪三振|だつさんしん}{王|おう}: strikeout leader (title for the pitcher with the most strikeouts)
